## Layer 2 Deep Intelligence Rules

You have no position they need unless you understand what's broken in their world. Generic value offers = orthodox. Pain-point solutions = side-door. - [COMPOUND-OBJECTIVE-MANDATORY] [BIZ] Every action in a side-door path MUST achieve ≥2 of: surface goal, hidden gain, relationship debt, intelligence extraction, positioning, dependency creation. - [PERSONA-PER-LINK] [BIZ] In introduction chains, founder presents a DIFFERENT persona to each person. Introducer sees operator. Lieutenant sees student. Target sees peer. LP sees expert. Design revelation sequence: competence first (week 1-2), value second (week 3-4), connections last (week 5-6 — triggers "discovery" illusion). NEVER reveal: wound map knowledge, chain design, strategic intent. (source: layer2-deep-intelligence, date: 2026-05-10)
- [HUMAN-VOICE-GATE] [BIZ] Operator voice output must score ≥70 on human-voice quality (output-voice-enforcer.py). Zero LLM artifacts: no markdown headers, no bullet lists, no tables, no framework names, no meta-language ("Let me explain"), no system artifact names (Wound Map, Compound Objective). Output reads like private notes from experienced mentor. (source: layer2-deep-intelligence, date: 2026-05-10)
```
